player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between several rooms, repeatedly visiting the same rooms in a cycle. What is worse, I failed to recognize when I had visited all the rooms and decided to stop the exploration. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have visited and make sure to stop the exploration when I have visited all the rooms. I will also try to avoid revisiting the same rooms by choosing a new direction when I encounter a room I have already visited.
